english.note: Use 挖 as the all-purpose verb for excavating earth and for taking potatoes or other things from the ground.

examples.english: We’re going to dig up sweet potatoes behind the hill tomorrow.
examples.traditional: 我哋聽日去後山挖番薯。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 ting1 jat6 heoi3 hau6 saan1 waa1 faan1 syu4
